en-US.description: Converts legacy QuarkXPress documents for use with newer QuarkXPress versions.
en-US.longDescription: QuarkXPress Document Converter converts legacy QuarkXPress 3.x through 6.x documents to QuarkXPress 9.1. Opening a converted document in a newer QuarkXPress version upgrades its text flow version.
en-US.name: QuarkXPress Document Converter
